audit.implication: proved bounds imply admitted thresholds a fortiori

cell.G0: (Z/2) wr Z lamplighter = (direct-sum_Z C2) semidirect Z

g1.note: base involution a=(delta_0,0), order 2, in S0

cell.presentation: a,t with a^2=e and all lamp conjugates commuting
cell.S: {e,g1} = pairs (f,0) with supp(f) subset of {0}, Joseph Sec.4 subgroup, order 2

chain_rule.N_i: p_i^k_i, p_i distinct odd primes, k_i minimal with N_i >= max(l_i/eps_i, 2*diam_i+2, |delta_i|+1)
chain_rule.A_i: f in direct-sum_Z C2 with even parity on each class of E_i; index 2^l_i
chain_rule.H_n: intersection_{i<=n} Gamma_i = A(n) semidirect L_n Z, L_n = product N_i
chain_rule.enumeration: G0 minus e by increasing weight w=|delta|+|supp|+diam, lexicographic ties; first six listed; fixed before computation

mass_bounds.S_fixed_equals_Fix_g1: S={e,g1}, so S-stabilized set equals Fix(g1)
mass_bounds.frequency_n: product_{i<=n}(N_i-l_i)/N_i (CRT on coprime odd cursor moduli; fibre size cancels)
mass_bounds.limit: decreasing clopen preimages give mu0(Fix(g1)) = infinite product >= product(1-eps_i) >= 7/8
mass_bounds.tower_leak: mu(Fix(g1) meet SV) <= |g1 S minus S| mu(V) <= mu(SV)/8 per tower, one-sided, g1 in S0

sample_castle.base_box: B = pairs (f,k) with supp f in [-24,24], k in [-24,24]; |B| = 49*2^49
sample_castle.shape: S = inverses of box B; |S|=|B|; left-(S0,1/8)-Foelner by inversion since S0 symmetric
sample_castle.boundary: right: Bt^{+-1} minus B is 2^49 each; Bt^{+-2} minus B is 2*2^49 each; Ba=B; total 6*2^49; ratio 6/49 < 1/8
sample_castle.disjointness: n* existential: finite S^{-1}S meets H_n trivially eventually and D_n>=4|S| eventually; |S| distinct cosets
sample_castle.Vstar: preimage of identity coset mod H_{n*}, mu = 1/Dstar
